# Feature-monitor compatibility fixture

`feature_monitor_v05_manifest.json` was generated by a clean installation of the
public v0.5.0 wheel (2026-10-25), not by the implementation under test:

https://github.com/dev-belly/CreditVintage/releases/download/v0.5.0/creditvintage_research-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl

Inputs: `generate(seed=7, per_vintage=10)`, `Config(seed=7)`, cutoff
`date(2024, 10, 1)`, `data_kind="synthetic"`. The saved manifest pins all six
artifact byte hashes and the normalized event-input digest. The regression
recreates that bundle with current code and requires the identical manifest.
